summary_markdown:
A discrepancy was discovered when comparing campaign data between old and new versions. The issue relates to the `numberOfAvgPeriods` parameter in the query, which changed from `1` (old version) to `4` (new version). Although visual comparison of the code showed little difference, this single change caused a significant calculation shift.

The immediate plan is to keep using `1` for the number of periods as a temporary measure. The full transition to the new value (`4`) will occur later when validation can be performed by someone else.
decisions: Temporarily use 1 for numberOfAvgPeriods in calculations.
action_items: Monitor calculation discrepancies and plan future switch to using 4 for numberOfAvgPeriods.
